title: One outdoor look: the street style is the forecourt's only look
caption: After Review street-style-default-1 the street style (leafy crowns, clipped hedges, brick and limestone, broad office panels, meadow) is the forecourt's look for everyone, with no ?diorama=1 switch. The other places never had a street-style version, so they look as before until the world kit (#367) builds one for them. The phone's overview leaves out the leaf cards, grass and bed cover cards and has a coarser crown, to stay near its budget. Left of each pair: main before the change; right: after, same spot and camera.

sections.title: The forecourt, desktop
sections.caption: Same spot and camera, before (left) and after (right). The desktop pictures are from the switch commit d11235f3; the later commits change the phone and the crowns' shadow.

sections.caption: Before (left), after on the final build (right): the phone's lighter street style.
